scientific.integrity: The universal proof is an induction over disjoint-union and join cotree nodes. An independent exact checker exhausts all labeled cographs through six vertices and all vertex permutations on them; this finite computation is corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is restricted to cographs and uniformly random vertex orders. It does not classify exact greedy uniformity on broader graph classes. The linear-time statement counts cotree arithmetic operations; maximal-independent-set counts may require growing integer bit lengths.

title: Exact random-greedy maximal-independent-set laws on cographs
